name: Affordable Robotic & Automation (ARAL)
tagline: Robotics/automation micro-cap where a multi-year holder just exited citing repeated missed targets
business_overview: ARAL is a niche player in robotics, automation, and industrial engineering equipment — a small business positioned on a long-term automation theme, but currently showing active fundamental deterioration.
fundamentals_table: Sept-2025 quarter down 35.86% YoY (Rs 28.04 Cr vs Rs 43.72 Cr)
fundamentals_narrative: Both ROE and ROCE are negative, revenue fell over a third year-on-year in the most recently reported quarter, and the stock is down 64% over the past year. This is active, not cosmetic, deterioration — the quality gate (real revenue/profit growth, ROCE/ROE strength) fails outright on current numbers.
technical_read: Sustained downtrend: -32.6% over 6 months and -64.0% over 12 months, with no reversal signal in the data pulled.
sentiment_summary: Moderately active ValuePickr thread (topic 20946, 94 posts, most recent post 2026-08-17).
community_signal: subhadeep_kundu (post dated 2026-08-17, invested since 2022) posted that management has repeatedly deferred/missed targets, that a subsidiary (ARAPL/RAAS) did not materialize as expected after a fund raise, and that despite the emerging-sector appeal there is 'too much red flag' — and exited the position this quarter. A specific, reasoned exit call from a multi-year holder, not a drive-by comment.
bull_case: Sits on a long-term robotics/automation theme with real structural tailwinds if execution improves
Micro-cap base (~Rs 220 Cr) means a genuine turnaround could re-rate sharply from depressed levels
Still listed and trading with no confirmed going-concern or negative-net-worth finding
bear_case: Negative ROE and ROCE alongside a >35% YoY revenue decline in the latest reported quarter — real fundamental deterioration
Stock down 64% over 12 months with no reversal signal
A multi-year ValuePickr holder just exited (Aug 2026) citing repeated missed management targets and an unresolved subsidiary/fund-raise issue — a specific, not generic, community red flag
verdict_headline: Fails the quality gate — negative returns, declining revenue, and a long-time holder just exited
verdict_reasoning: Negative ROE/ROCE and a sharp YoY revenue decline mean this is not real, current growth by any definition used in this screen
The community signal reinforces the numbers rather than contradicting them — a specific, reasoned exit from someone invested since 2022
No formal red-flag tier applies (no confirmed negative net worth, promoter-holding collapse, or SEBI action), but the fundamentals alone are enough to exclude this from further consideration for now

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: 'negative ROE/ROCE and a sharp YoY revenue decline mean this is not real, current growth by any definition' (tailwind=no); community signal (a reasoned exit) reinforces rather than contradicts the numbers.
